image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a child's hands and feet on a light wood floor. The left hand holds a red beaded bracelet. The right foot has two adhesive bandages applied: one rectangular pink patterned bandage on the top of the foot near the toes, and a smaller square beige bandage on the side of the big toe. A green box of 'Hello Kitty' themed bandages is visible in the bottom right corner. The child is wearing a red skirt with gold trim.
